done.label: Done / proven
done.meaning: Implemented and supported by relevant tests or proofs.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.meaning: Shell or foundation exists, but placement/functionality/proof coverage is incomplete.

not-implemented.label: Not implemented
not-implemented.meaning: Documented requirement exists, but there is no working implementation yet.

elements.label: setup.sh / Preflight actions
elements.summary: Visual-only in this slice. No backend action is wired from V2.

elements.label: setup.sh / 2A Database controls
elements.summary: B4.2 reuses the existing database init action/result/log pipeline in the V2 Setup page. It exposes Check DB, Inspect DB, Delete DB, and Recreate DB through the existing browser action handlers and documented /api/init/database/* endpoints.

elements.label: setup.sh / Setup scope
elements.summary: v2 setup is preflight/orchestration only. It may check and report readiness, but it does not install full dependencies in this slice.

elements.label: setup.sh / 1A Verify .env
elements.summary: B4.1 reuses the existing verify-env action/result/log pipeline in the V2 Setup page. It calls POST /api/init/verify-env through the existing runtime-truth action and renders the shared latest backend result and local log surfaces.

elements.label: authentication.sh / Authentication actions
elements.summary: Visual-only in this slice. No backend action is wired from V2.

elements.label: authentication.sh / Local-only authentication boundary
elements.summary: This page owns only local iCloudPD login/session flow. It must not display raw credentials, 2FA codes, cookies, session files, or secret paths without an existing redaction contract.

elements.label: authentication.sh / 1A-STASH-OFF - NEW AUTH
elements.summary: B4.3 reuses the existing NEW AUTH button states, /api/auth/new/* action IDs, shared latest-result rendering, and sanitized log/result surfaces in the V2 Authentication page. The existing secret/redaction boundary remains in force.

elements.label: authentication.sh / iCloudPD session status
elements.summary: Session status placeholder. No session read/write action is executed from V2 in this slice.

elements.label: startup.sh / .env / environment variables
elements.summary: If .env does not exist, a later guarded implementation may create it from defaults/example values. Missing defaults must be a non-crashing error.

elements.label: startup.sh / database
elements.summary: Database inspection and maintenance actions. Destructive operations must stay guarded.

elements.label: startup.sh / crontab
elements.summary: Crontab reads are safe to expose visually; writes must be previewed and guarded.

elements.label: startup.sh / install custom worker
elements.summary: Linked worker type + schedule selector row. Installation must remain previewable and guarded because it writes crontab.

elements.label: startup.sh / 3A Scheduler controls
elements.summary: B5.1 renders the Raspberry-focused scheduler controls in V2 Startup. The visible button labels keep the existing scheduler concepts while the buttons carry the Raspberry real-crontab target through existing scheduler backend handlers.

elements.label: startup.sh / RPI-STAGES media pipeline stage row
elements.summary: B5.2 adds the shared Raspberry media pipeline stage row to Startup with Download, Index, GPS parser, Geocode, and Queue cards, all intentionally Idle until real worker calls run.

elements.label: startup.sh / Startup sections
elements.summary: These are grouped center-panel sections, not nested sidebar routes.

elements.label: workers / current status
elements.summary: Summary placeholder for regular worker, playback worker, and screen on-off worker status.

elements.label: workers / regular worker
elements.summary: Repeated stage rows. Batch size is a stage setting/display, not a navigation item. Rich statistics are v3 placeholders.

elements.label: workers / playback worker
elements.summary: Current status and current image/video placeholder. Later hover/enter details may show full filename, GPS coordinates, and parsed address.

elements.label: workers / screen on-off worker
elements.summary: Toggle rows are visual-only until backend contracts exist.

elements.label: workers / statistics page
elements.summary: v2 may collect runtime statistics; the rich statistics page remains v3.0.

elements.label: workers / RPI-STAGES media pipeline stage row
elements.summary: B5.2 adds the same shared Raspberry media pipeline stage row to Workers so stage health is visible where worker controls will be added.

elements.label: troubleshooting / manual troubleshooting actions
elements.summary: Visual-only actions. Clear/delete operations are guarded placeholders.

elements.label: troubleshooting / examples (*EX)
elements.summary: Examples are scenario/rule seeds, not executable actions. Promotion requires measurable condition, threshold, duration, handling, log output, proof/evidence output, and operator explanation.

elements.label: troubleshooting / error logging / error handling
elements.summary: Page-specific error logs, combined/global error log, global high-priority error log, and final outer-layer catch/log handling before exit when possible.

elements.label: troubleshooting / logging / log handling
elements.summary: Page-specific logs, global log, full verbose log, high-importance regular log, and conditional actions from measurable rules.

elements.label: troubleshooting / RPI-STAGES media pipeline stage row
elements.summary: B5.2 adds the same shared Raspberry media pipeline stage row to Troubleshooting for diagnostic visibility without running any stage.

elements.label: recovery / snapshot metadata
elements.summary: Shows latest snapshot time and other snapshot-level metadata later. No state read/write happens from V2 in this slice.

elements.label: recovery / current backup snapshot generation policy
elements.summary: Human-readable policy text placeholder. Changing policy may involve AI later and is not wired now.

elements.label: recovery / current snapshot
elements.summary: Human-readable structure, raw item/field list, and JSON-like values placeholder.

elements.label: recovery / current backup snapshot
elements.summary: Latest saved backup snapshot inspection placeholder before restore.

elements.label: recovery / currently stored backup snapshots
elements.summary: Navigable stored-snapshot list placeholder with protocol version and compatibility status later.

elements.label: recovery / snapshot actions
elements.summary: Save/restore are visual-only. Restore must require selection, confirmation, compatibility check, and before/after summary when implemented for real.

elements.label: PIR / PIR implementation boundary
elements.summary: Mouse and keyboard activity can be tested directly later. Real PIR hardware integration remains future; initial V2 behavior should use an emulator button.

elements.label: 07 PIR shell blocks
elements.summary: B1 shell/explanation blocks for the future isolated PIR page.

elements.label: PLAYBACK / Playback implementation boundary
elements.summary: The drag/drop queue, metadata table, non-media handling, rendering controls, and address-missing toggle are planned but not implemented in this route-shell batch.

elements.label: 08 PLAYBACK shell blocks
elements.summary: B1 shell/explanation blocks for the future isolated playback page.

elements.label: 09 REAL PLAYBACK explanation blocks
elements.summary: B1 explanation-only blocks for the final integrated endpoint page.

elements.label: REAL PLAYBACK / Future source pages
elements.summary: These entries document the planned composition sources. They are disabled explanation items, not functional controls.

elements.summary: 08 PLAYBACK route/page shell is implemented. Real B4 controls and drag/drop queue are future B8 work.

elements.label: 09 REAL PLAYBACK
elements.summary: 09 REAL PLAYBACK route/page shell is implemented as explanation-only. Final integration remains future until isolated pieces are proven.

elements.label: 06 RECOVERY
elements.summary: Existing visual-only V2 page. Recovery placeholder buttons and real recovery are future batches.

elements.label: 01 SETUP
elements.summary: Existing visual-only V2 page. Requested real setup cards are not moved in this batch.

elements.label: 03 STARTUP
elements.summary: V2 Startup now contains the Raspberry scheduler controls plus shared RPI-STAGES visual row. Worker execution proof remains later.

elements.label: 05 TROUBLESHOOTING
elements.summary: V2 Troubleshooting now contains the shared RPI-STAGES visual row. Stale-lock controls remain future.

elements.label: 04 WORKERS
elements.summary: V2 Workers now contains the shared RPI-STAGES visual row. B3.1-B3.5 worker controls are still future until B5.4.

elements.label: V2 Event history panel
elements.summary: Reuses the existing event-history renderer and copy/clear actions inside V2 pages.

elements.label: Shared V2 page wrapper
elements.summary: Reusable V2 shell foundation that owns sidebar/main layout and shared event-history placement.

elements.label: V2 status/help metadata foundation
elements.summary: Structured metadata backing future Explain controls, Explain values, and Implementation status overlays.
